sources.title: Claude Opus - Learn AI
sources.snippet: Claude Opus is the highest-capability model tier in Anthropic 's Claude family of large language models, designed for the most complex reasoning, advanced coding, and long-horizon agentic tasks that demand frontier intelligence.
